Technical Engineering Manager, Chronicle

The Technical Engineering Manager, Chronicle is responsible for the people, delivery, and technical direction of the chronicle engineering team at Hanzo. This is a hands-on management role for a technical leader who can create clarity, develop engineers, manage performance, and help the team deliver secure and reliable enterprise software.

The Technical Engineering Manager will work closely with Product, Technical Delivery and Support, Security, and company leadership to translate business and customer needs into realistic engineering priorities and outcomes.

About Hanzo

Hanzo helps corporate legal and compliance teams understand and manage dynamic web enterprise content. Our software supports their internal teams with SEC/FINRA, PCAOB, FTC and other compliance audits they undergo with defensible preservation, targeted collection, and efficient review of content from social media and complex websites.

The role

You will serve as both the people manager and technical leader for the Chronicle engineering team. You will translate company and product priorities into clear team goals, establish effective ways of working, and remain close enough to the technology to guide decisions and support engineers.

Your primary responsibility is working closely with Product to obtain roadmap priorities, helping them break the epics down to individual tickets and enabling the team to succeed. You will also contribute directly when appropriate by reviewing designs and code, supporting complex technical work, resolving blockers, and helping manage production incidents.

This is not intended to be a full-time manager or individual contributor role. It is a dual-role for a small team. Hands-on technical work should support the team’s effectiveness, while coaching them, keeping them accountable and supporting their career growth.

People leadership responsibilities

  • Serve as the direct line manager for assigned engineers and take responsibility for their day-to-day employee experience.
  • Establish clear expectations, responsibilities, objectives, and accountability.
  • Hold monthly one-to-one meetings and provide timely, specific, and constructive feedback.
  • Coach and develop team members through individual growth goals, stretch opportunities, and practical support.
  • Set individual objectives and development plans, assess progress, address performance concerns promptly and fairly, and recognize strong contributions.
  • Prepare evidence-based performance reviews and lead review conversations.
  • Approve time-off requests while balancing employee wellbeing, team coverage, and delivery commitments.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, career development,
  • Addressing people matters in partnership with HR.
  • Monitor workload, engagement, wellbeing, and team dynamics.
  • Create an inclusive and respectful environment in which engineers can raise concerns, challenge ideas, learn, and do their best work.
  • Lead effectively across different countries, cultures, and time zones in a remote environment.

Delivery and team leadership responsibilities

  • Own the team’s delivery commitments and establish realistic plans based on Product’s list of priorities, capacity, dependencies, technical debt, and risk.
  • Translate product, customer, architecture, and business priorities into clear engineering outcomes.
  • Facilitate planning, prioritization, and execution while maintaining clear ownership within the team.
  • Remove blockers and escalate delivery, resource, or technical risks early.
  • Monitor progress and communicate status, risks, trade-offs, and changes clearly to Product and leadership..
  • Work closely with Product to balance new product development, customer commitments, defects, support bugs, cloud performance and cost, technical debt, and operational improvements.
  • Strengthen engineering practices related to estimation, documentation, testing, code review, release management, incident response, and continuous improvement.
  • Use delivery and operational data to identify recurring problems and improve team effectiveness.
  • Coordinate work across Product, Technical Delivery and Support, Security, and other engineering teams.

Technical leadership responsibilities

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to guide architecture, system design, and implementation decisions across the team’s areas of responsibility.
  • Maintain appropriate standards for secure, reliable, maintainable, documented, testable, and observable software.
  • Review technical designs and code to provide feedback to your team members and continue to improve the effectiveness of the team.
  • Help engineers evaluate trade-offs involving reliability, performance, scale, security, delivery speed, and maintainability.
  • Ensure appropriate ownership of production systems, operational issues, incidents, defects, and technical debt.
  • Work closely with the Technical Delivery and Support team to support incident response and lead effective follow-up when significant technical or customer issues occur.
  • Encourage the reuse of proven patterns, tools, and platform capabilities.
  • Identify technical risks and ensure they are understood, prioritized, and addressed.
  • Stay sufficiently close to the codebase and technical domain to ask strong questions, coach engineers, and make informed decisions.
  • Work with Security to ensure engineering practices support Hanzo’s security and compliance obligations.

Customer and cross-functional responsibilities

  • Work closely with Product to participate in customer discussions when technical expertise or Engineering leadership is needed.
  • Help investigate and resolve complex customer escalations.
  • Ensure customer needs are translated into clear technical requirements without bypassing agreed product and engineering priorities.
  • Communicate technical issues, risks, and options in language appropriate for nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Build effective working relationships across the organization.

What you will bring

  • Experience leading software engineers, coaching, feedback, and performance management.
  • Strong technical credibility gained through hands-on software engineering experience.
  • Experience delivering enterprise software or complex SaaS products.
  • Strong experience with Python, or deep experience with Java or C# combined
  • Experience with distributed systems, large data volumes, concurrency, scaling, APIs, and complex technical problems.
  • Experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with Agile or Kanban delivery, continuous deployment, and modern deployment tools.
  • Sound judgment, self-awareness, and a consistent approach to accountability and employee support.
  • Ability to balance people leadership, technical leadership, client needs, and delivery expectations.

Helpful experience

Experience with NoSQL technologies such as Cassandra or CouchDB.

  • Experience supporting security, compliance, or data-governance products.
  • Experience leading teams through technical modernization, operational improvement, or scaling challenges.

How success will be measured

Qualifications

Experience:

About the Company

We are hiring a Sr AI AWS Engineer who has actually built AI/ML applications in cloud—not just read about them. This role centers on hands-on development of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, fine-tuning LLMs, and AWS-native microservices that drive automation, insight, and governance in an enterprise environment. You’ll design and deliver scalable, secure services that bring large language models into real operational use—connecting them to live infrastructure data, internal documentation, and system telemetry.

You’ll be part of a high-impact team pushing the boundaries of cloud-native AI in a real-world enterprise setting. This is not a prompt-engineering sandbox or a resume keyword trap. If you’ve merely dabbled in BedRock, mentioned RAG on LinkedIn, or read about vector search—this isn’t the right fit. We’re looking for candidates who have architected, developed, and supported AI/ML services in production environments.

This is a builder’s role within our Public Cloud AWS Engineering team. We aren’t hiring buzzword lists or conference attendees. If you’ve built something you’re proud of—especially if it involved real infrastructure, real data, and real users—we’d love to talk. If you’re still learning, that’s great too—but this isn’t an entry-level role or a theory-only position.

Hands-on role using AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3).

Responsible for the implementation of AWS cloud services including infrastructure, machine learning, and artificial intelligence platform services.

Experience with LLM-based applications, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using LangChain and other frameworks.

Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into secure, scalable AI systems.

Own the software release lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, GitHub-based SDLC, and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

Support the development and evolution of reusable platform components for AI/ML operations.

Create and maintain technical documentation for the team to reference and share with our internal customers.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

7 years of hands-on software engineering experience with a strong focus on Python.

Experienced with AWS services, especially Bedrock or SageMaker

Familiar with fine-tuning large language models or building datasets and/or deploying ML models to production.

Demonstrated experience with AWS organizations and policy guardrails (SCP, AWS Config).

Solid experience implementing RAG architectures and LangChain.

Demonstrated experience in Infrastructure as Code best practices and experience with building Terraform modules for AWS cloud.

Strong background in Git-based version control, code reviews, and DevOps workflows.

Demonstrated success delivering production-ready software with release pipeline integration.

AWS or relevant cloud certifications.

Policy as Code development (e.g., Terraform Sentinel).

Experience with Hugging Face, Golang, or Node.js.

Exposure to FinOps and cloud cost optimization.

Data science background or experience working with structured/unstructured data.

Awareness of data privacy and compliance best practices (e.g., PII handling, secure model deployment).

What You’ll Get

Competitive base salary

Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage

Optional life and disability insurance provided

401(k) with a company match and optional profit sharing

Paid vacation time

Paid Bench time

Training allowance offering

You’ll be eligible to earn referral bonuses!

jobs.description:
Credit Sesame is a leading financial wellness platform dedicated to helping consumers achieve better financial health through cutting-edge technology and data-driven solutions. With a decade of credit expertise and a proven track record of serving over 18 million users, Credit Sesame leverages AI and advanced analytics to empower individuals to better understand and manage their credit. Our recently launched Sesame Platform extends our mission by providing financial institutions with a turnkey AI-powered credit intelligence solution.

As our security engineer, you'll own security end-to-end for our platform — standing up open-source tooling, writing your own scripts and automation, and running assessments.

You'll...
  • Run security reviews for new tools, vendors, and projects — data handling, AI usage, DPAs, PII, authentication/authorization, and third-party security reports (SOC 2, PCI, ISO, pentest results);
  • Own access and infrastructure security — IAM least-privilege reviews, S3/database access controls, environment segregation, service-to-service authentication, and network configuration audits (VPC flow logs, inbound/outbound rules);
  • Run vulnerability management across cloud and endpoints, and manage IDS/IPS (e.g., Palo Alto Panorama, AWS WAF) and EDR/MDR tooling;
  • Lead security incident response end to end — triage, investigate, contain, document, and build the runbooks as you go;
  • Implement and maintain the technical controls supporting our PCI DSS and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance programs, including internal audits, risk metrics, and disaster recovery planning;
  • Partner with DevOps/IT on patch management and secure infrastructure defaults, and present tooling and risk recommendations to engineering leadership;
  • Build our in-house AppSec scanning program — evaluate and pilot SAST/SCA/IaC tooling (Semgrep, Trivy, Upwind), integrate into GitLab CI and Jenkins, define severity-based remediation SLAs, and drive rollout across services;
  • Build internal security tooling and automation — custom scripts and integrations (Python/boto3, APIs) that pull data from tools without native integrations into shared dashboards and reports;
  • Build and tune detection pipelines — for example, feeding traffic/bot-protection alerts (Datadome) into our log platform (ELK/Kibana) and writing rules that catch real attack patterns;
  • Threat-model and pentest our AI/LLM systems — scope risks like prompt injection and data exfiltration through MCP servers, coordinate external pentests where needed, and drive remediation;
  • Maintain security policies and practices and drive training and adoption throughout the company.
You're a great fit because...
  • You have 7+ years of hands-on security engineering experience across application security, cloud security, and network/penetration testing — not just one lane;
  • You've driven tooling or architecture decisions independently (evaluated options, made the call, defended it to leadership);
  • You're self-directed, pragmatic, and ruthless about prioritization;
  • You've built production automation from scratch — API integrations, custom collectors, or internal tooling — not just one-off scripts;
  • You have hands-on experience deploying and running OSS security tools — Burp Suite Community/OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nuclei, Metasploit, Semgrep, Trivy, Wazuh/OSSEC, ELK/Kibana, Prowler/ScoutSuite, HashiCorp Vault, or similar;
  • You have solid AWS security experience;
  • You have working knowledge of PCI DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 — enough to implement controls and support audits;
  • You're curious about emerging security domains and comfortable threat-modeling systems (like AI/LLM applications) that don't have an established playbook yet;
  • You're an excellent communicator who can translate cost/coverage tradeoffs and technical risk for both engineers and executives;
  • Bonus: OSCP, GPEN, or similar certifications; bug bounty experience; prior experience at a startup; or experience securing LLM/AI-based systems;
  • BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

You'll love it here because...

  • You’ll have equity in a pre-IPO company backed by top VCs;
  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance;
  • We offer a monthly home office stipend;
  • We offer a professional development program to support your continued growth
  • We offer flexible paid time off;
  • We have 10 paid holidays and additional 6 Sesame Wellness days;
  • We prize EQ and empathy, and have a culture that emphasizes total wellness, including work-life harmony.
At Credit Sesame, base pay is one part of our total compensation package. The estimated pay range for this role is $170,000 - $215,000 with actual salary based on a candidate’s location, qualifications, skills, and experience. Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Credit Sesame’s equity plans.

We are open to hiring for this role in the following states where we are set up to hire employees: CA, CO, NC, NJ, NV, and TX.

About us:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.

Foodsmart is seeking compassionate and mission-driven Registered Dietitians (RDs) to join our growing Foodsmart Nutrition Network. As a Foodsmart RD, you’ll deliver virtual Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and personalized care to members—many of whom are Medicaid participants or facing food insecurity.

  • Guide access to affordable, healthy groceries through our online marketplace
  • Connect members with local food and nutrition resources
  • Support sustainable meal planning and healthy habits for families
  • Deliver MNT to manage or prevent chronic conditions
  • Provide personalized virtual nutrition care via secure video and messaging

jobs.description:
Overview

The Partner Program Manager is a key individual contributor within Seismic’s Global Partnerships organization responsible for the day-to-day execution of programs, processes, enablement, and content that help our partner ecosystem operate effectively and scale.

Reporting to the Partner Program Director, this role will support partner onboarding and enablement, program operations, partner-facing and revenue-facing content, reporting, and the operational workflows that keep our ecosystem running smoothly. This person will work closely with Partner Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure partners and Seismic teams have the information, resources, and support they need to execute.

We are looking for a strong operator with exceptional attention to detail and a bias toward action. The right person is organized, proactive, comfortable managing multiple workstreams, and motivated by making complex processes easier for others.

This is an opportunity for someone with a strong operational foundation who wants to deepen their expertise in partnerships and ecosystem strategy. You will begin by owning critical execution and, over time, have the opportunity to grow from an exceptional operator into a program builder.

Who you are:

  • 3–4+ years of experience in partner programs, partner operations, sales enablement, revenue operations, program management, or a related role within a B2B technology company.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs, deadlines, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously.
  • Experience supporting enablement, onboarding, content management, or operational programs for partners or revenue-facing teams.
  • Strong project and program management skills with a track record of driving work from intake through completion.
  • Comfortable working with data, reporting, systems, and documentation to maintain program accuracy and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who can work effectively across Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, Services, and other teams.
  • Proactive, curious, and eager to learn, with a willingness to get into the details while developing the strategic skills required to take on greater ownership over time.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Love making things organized, accurate, and easy to use.
  • Are energized by execution and take pride in making sure the details are right.
  • Can manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of deadlines, dependencies, or follow-through.
  • Look for ways to make recurring work simpler, faster, and more scalable.
  • Are comfortable working across teams and proactively follow up to keep work moving.
  • Enjoy learning how partnerships, Sales, Product, and Marketing come together to drive business outcomes.
  • Want to master execution today while developing the skills to build and own programs tomorrow.

What you'll be doing:

  • Execute partner programs and operations. Support the day-to-day execution of partner programs, processes, workflows, and recurring operating cadences established by the Partner Program Director.
  • Manage partner onboarding. Coordinate onboarding for new partners, ensuring required information, agreements, systems access, enablement, documentation, and internal handoffs are completed accurately and on time.
  • Support partner and field enablement. Coordinate enablement programs and maintain resources that help partners understand Seismic and help Seismic’s revenue teams understand when, where, and how to engage our partner ecosystem.
  • Own partner-related content activities. Manage partner content that supports revenue-facing use cases, ensuring assets are accurate, appropriately tagged, easy to discover, and aligned to current partner strategies and offerings. Maintain content freshness through regular reviews, updates, version control, and archiving of outdated materials.
  • Maintain partner resources and documentation. Keep playbooks, partner profiles, enablement materials, process documentation, FAQs, templates, and other internal and external resources current and organized.
  • Support reporting and partner program-related measurements. Maintain program trackers, scorecards, dashboards, and recurring reporting; ensure data quality and help surface trends, gaps, and actions for the Partner Program Director and broader Partnerships team.
  • Drive partner ecosystem operational coordination and continuous improvement. Work across Partner Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, Services, Legal, and other stakeholders to track deliverables, remove operational blockers, document processes, and identify opportunities to simplify or automate recurring work.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, the Partner Program Manager will:

  • Establish reliable, consistent execution across core partner programs and partner-related operational workflows.
  • Improve the quality and consistency of partner onboarding, creating a clear and effective experience for new partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain a high-quality library of partner and revenue-facing content that is accurate, current, appropriately tagged, easily discoverable, and regularly reviewed for updates or archiving.
  • Improve partner and field enablement by ensuring the right resources, materials, and information are available when teams need them.
  • Maintain accurate program tracking, reporting, and documentation that gives the Partnerships organization clear visibility into execution and outstanding actions.
  • Build strong working relationships across Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, Services, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrate increasing ownership by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, solve recurring operational problems, and improve how partner programs scale.

Job Details:

Want to help entrepreneurs all over the world build life-changing relationships and inspiring content? Through done-for-you podcast services, we help businesses grow, expand their outreach, and leave a lasting legacy.

Job Description:

We are looking for a remote, initially part-time financial planning analyst who can create budgets and financial forecasts for a growing multiple 7 figure marketing agency business. You will review our books each month, project growth in revenue and costs, including what we should budget for all of the major categories in the P&L on an annual and rolling basis. You will report to Co-CEO John Corcoran and be responsible for proactively providing executive management with support and advice on hiring, spending and operational challenges as they arise. ​​​​​​

​Your job will be to proactively predict business changes, develop budgets, and help us understand what we are doing right so we can do more of it and also what we are doing wrong so that we can anticipate growth and development issues and accelerate our business. As with any small, high growth business, there are many hats to wear, and another important related function will be to oversee the quality control of our monthly accounting close process which is managed by our Controller. Your help identifying challenges before they slip through, using trend analysis and monthly analytical reviews will enhance your ability to deeply understand the business’s nuts and bolts, strengthening both our forecasting results and our underlying accounting data which forms the basis for those forecasts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • With support from our fractional CFO, develop annual budget processes and apply those processes to develop and recommend annual financial budgets for the company.
  • Similarly develop various recurring monthly, quarterly and annual financial review and forecasting processes including various levels of reporting and tracking and use those processes to develop reporting procedures which permit appropriate communication of company goals and performance results both to executive management and within the company departmental and employee base. Assist in leading those communications throughout the business.
  • Prepare forecasts and analysis trends in sales, finance, general business conditions and other related areas as required.
  • Perform both quantitative and qualitative analysis of all operational aspects of the company to evaluate the company’s progress toward achieving its goals and to map out and/or adjust future goals and plans.
  • Identify favorable and unfavorable revenue and spending trends and work with our existing staff Controller, bookkeeper and fractional CFO to provide analytic and detailed transactional results and recommendations for improved performance and efficiency.
  • Perform financial statement review to review the actual expense versus budget and issue monthly variance statements along with explanations of significant variances and recommendations to mitigate negative variances.
  • Develop a limited, impactful set of Key Performance Indicators, as well various supporting transformational financial and operational metrics to better understand the business’s operating dynamics and develop supporting financial models and decision-support tools to mechanize appropriate decision processes.
  • Work directly with our Controller to review the monthly accounting close process and analyze results using trend analysis to maximize the accuracy of the process.
  • Provide return on investment (ROI) analysis for client projects.
  • Other duties as assigned by the management.

This position is remote and self-paced. You can work from anywhere with a good Internet connection. We are looking for someone who will devote at least 20 or more hours per week. If you have fewer hours available, we will work with the successful candidate so long as there is a clear, agreed upon pathway and timeframe to a role that is half-time or more given the workload involved.

You must be good at self-direction and taking initiative. In addition, it is important to us that all of our team members are detail-oriented and meticulous; therefore, in the application form, when it asks for your “favorite vegetable?” Please put the word “eggplant.”

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years Financial Planning and Analysis experience in a fast-paced entrepreneurial organization. Experience in a marketing agency environment will make you a rockstar.
  • You are true self-starter and relish working independently for the greater good of a people oriented organization. Our organization is fully virtual and it takes someone who loves what they do and wants to do it well and effectively to make us and themselves truly successful.
  • You are nice – we spend a lot of time working and we like to work with nice people.
  • You are quick with communication via email and Slack.
  • You speak English flawlessly (even if you are not a native English speaker).
  • You are detail oriented and meticulous about checking your work for factual and mathematical errors.
  • You are very organized and can use documents in Google Drive.
  • You have access to reliable Internet services at all times.

Who We Are:

Rise25, LLC is a company on a mission to help businesses connect with their ideal prospects, referral partners, and strategic partners using a podcast.

Co-founders Dr. Jeremy Weisz, a chiropractor turned serial entrepreneur, and John Corcoran, a former White House writer and speechwriter, were early adopters of the podcasting medium and between them have over 25+ years of combined experience with podcasting. Today, Rise25 works with top-notch B2B businesses around the globe, including one of the nation’s largest ticket sellers, consulting firms, law firms, and more. Learn more at: www.Rise25.com/about

Why Rise25:

The 100% remote team at Rise25 prioritizes flexibility, so you can work where and when you want, as long as you get your job done. Although we have team members all across the globe, we strive to build a culture of one team working together toward a common goal.

Monthly Book and Masterclass Club meetings - One of our core values is to Keep Learning, so we pay for our entire team to join our Book and Masterclass Club, where we have monthly meetings to discuss one book or masterclass we have all read or watched together.

jobs.description:
Overview

Your Future. Secured. ISC2 is a force for good. As the world’s leading nonprofit member organization for cybersecurity professionals, our core values — Integrity, Advocacy, Commitment, Inclusion, and Excellence — drive everything we do in support of our vision of a safe and secure cyber world. Our globally recognized, award-winning portfolio of certifications provide an independent and globally recognized endorsement of cybersecurity knowledge, skills and experience for all career levels. Our charitable arm, the Center for Cyber Safety and Education, enables ISC2 and our members to serve the public by educating the most vulnerable about cyber risks and empowering access to enter and thrive in the cyber profession. Learn more at ISC2 online and connect with us on Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn. When you join ISC2, you’ll demonstrate your commitment to an inclusive and equitable environment. Your support of the unique perspectives and experiences shared by our global cybersecurity workforce and profession will be recognized. We invite you to take an active role in helping us create a true sense of belonging across our organization — an environment of authenticity, trust, empowerment and connectedness that empowers all of our successes. Learn more.

Position Summary

ISC2 is building a modern lakehouse and using it to run machine learning across the membership business. This role covers the whole path, from the pipelines that produce the data through to results a stakeholder actually uses. The Lakehouse Machine Learning (ML) Engineer writes production Python and Spark against a governed lakehouse, spends real time exploring data before deciding what’s worth modeling, and deploys and monitors models once they’re live. As the platform matures there is room to take on applied LLM work. The lakehouse runs on Azure Databricks; deep experience on a comparable stack transfers.

**This position is not available to residents of California**.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python/Spark pipelines through bronze, silver, and gold layers, plus the semantic datasets and ML models that consume them.
  • Dig into the data before modeling it. Work out what it can support, build and test the features that come out of that exploration, then coordinate with stakeholders about which questions are worth answering and which aren’t.
  • Work across a range of model types: survival and time-to-event, forecasting, classification and propensity, sequence models, recommenders, causal evaluation.
  • Put models into production and keep them there - Experiment tracking, model registry, scheduled inference, and monitoring for drift and decay once they’re live.
  • Get results to the people who need them. That means landing output in governed semantic tables feeding dashboards and CDP systems, and being able to walk a business team through what the numbers mean.
  • Take on applied LLM work as the platform matures, including structured extraction from free text, and retrieval over governed data.
  • Build inside the platform’s security and governance requirements rather than around them. Access controls, data protection, auditability, and human review where model output drives a decision that affects a member.
  • Turn what works into reusable patterns, including project templates, shared feature and evaluation code, and implementation standards, so the next model doesn’t start from a blank notebook.
  • Prove things out before they get built for real - Small proofs of concept that establish whether the data supports the theory, whether the approach holds up, and whether the result can actually be operated once it’s live.
  • Perform miscellaneous duties, as required.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and documentation rigor.
  • Collaborative, intellectually curious, and proactive in identifying analytical opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Strong Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) skills, with the ability to assemble a dataset rather than request one.
  • Fluent Python and SQL skills, comfortable working across enterprise source systems, and fluent with the standard ML stack — scikit-learn at minimum, and at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Knowledge range in ML, including knowing when timing matters enough to warrant survival analysis over a churn classifier, and being able to tell a causal question from a predictive one.
  • Familiarity with hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, and the techniques used to confirm a model holds up on data it has not seen.
  • Ability to perform careful model validation, and to provide clarity about uncertainty. Also, to perform model evaluation and bias mitigation, judgment about where a person needs to stay in the loop, and the ability to explain the result to executives in non-technical terms.
  • Understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance constraints, as well as how they shape what can be built with member data. Ability to work within the confines of access controls, data protection, and auditability.
  • Knowledge of Databricks, including Unity Catalog, Workflows, MLflow, a plus.
  • Ability to perform cohort-based or hierarchical forecasting at scale, a plus.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, a plus.
  • Relevant certifications: Databricks Data Engineer or Machine Learning Associate/Professional, Azure AI Engineer or Data Scientist Associate, or equivalent, a plus.

Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in an IT field preferred. Will consider candidates with a high school diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering and applied machine learning, preferably in enterprise environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering and applied machine learning, preferably in enterprise environments.
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models in production. ML flow or an equivalent tracking, registry, and scheduled-inference stack.
  • Production experience building in a medallion architecture — bronze, silver, and gold, or an equivalent layered model — in a data-catalog-governed environment. Distributed processing with Spark or a comparable engine, an open table format such as Delta or Iceberg, and catalog-managed schemas, lineage, and access control. Demonstrated experience building and operating in that environment, not just querying it.

  • Practical Large Language Model (LLM) experience including embeddings and retrieval, structured extraction, evaluation, a plus.

  • Experience with subscription or membership-lifecycle data, a plus.

  • Experience running a build-versus-buy evaluation. Hands-on assessment of tools and vendors, and a recommendation that can be defended, a plus.

Physical and Mental Demands

  • Up to 5% travel may be required.
  • Work normal business hours and extended hours when necessary.
  • Remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting, for prolonged periods.
  • Regular use of office equipment in a remote environment such as a computer/laptop and monitor computer screens.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other computer components.

Total Rewards

The pay range for this position is $93,000 - $118,900/Yr.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

Information regarding our comprehensive benefits package is available here.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 5 calendar days. This is a current vacancy, and the employer intends to fill this position within approximately 30 days.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic as protected by applicable law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Fazer parte de um time de desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços na linguagem Java, atuando com clientes da América Latina, incluindo contas de infraestrutura crítica do setor financeiro/bancário, em um cenário de expansão de portfólio (novos projetos e contas chegando de forma acelerada na região).

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Participação nos ritos de agilidade do time de desenvolvimento;
  • Design e desenvolvimento de APIs;
  • Desenvolvimento de microsserviços em Java com Spring Boot;
  • Evolução e manutenção de APIs em contas já em produção, incluindo trabalhos de migração de APIs legadas para arquiteturas mais modernas;
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento (secure coding), dado o contexto de clientes que operam infraestrutura crítica e são alvo frequente de tentativas de ataque;
  • Atuação simultânea em mais de um cliente/contexto de negócio, conforme a alocação do time e o volume de contas ativas em Latam;
  • Colaboração com squads distribuídos entre Brasil e outros países da região, incluindo interlocução ocasional em espanhol com stakeholders locais;
  • Contribuição para a maturidade de processos do time (documentação técnica, ownership claro de serviços, boas práticas de versionamento e deploy), em um ambiente onde esses processos ainda estão em consolidação.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência com Java 17+
  • Experiência com testes unitários JUnit 5
  • Experiência com Docker e Docker Compose
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais
  • Experiência com design e desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful
  • Experiência com Spring Boot
  • Experiência com GIT
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensageria
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações cloud native
  • Conhecimento nos recursos AWS: IAM, S3, EC2, Lambda, SQS, SNS, ECS, EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, Event Bridge
  • Conhecimento em API Gateway
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Espanhol

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada à eventos
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes
  • Conhecimento em padrões de microsserviços
  • Conhecimento em Golang
  • Conhecimento em Javascript
  • Conhecimento em Open Finance
  • Espanhol avançado/fluente

    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

jobs.description:
About the role

The Workforce Manager leads end-to-end workforce strategy and operational execution for a dedicated, large-scale Rapid Data Center Deployment (RDD) program. Acting as the single point of contact for account-level resource planning, this role ensures field workforce capacity, specialized skill sets, and deployment readiness are tightly aligned with project timelines, deployment schedules, and customer SLAs. This position bridges strategy and execution—governing demand forecasting, resource allocation, and field readiness while serving as the primary escalation point for staffing constraints and workforce operational risks.

Location: Saline, MI

What you'll be doing

Capacity Planning & Forecasting

  • Partner with account leadership and project management to build robust demand models, translating project timelines and deployment schedules into precise headcount, skill, and location requirements.
  • Run scenario analyses to evaluate the workforce impact of scope changes, site delays, or accelerated timelines, establishing buffer strategies to mitigate risk without over-allocating budget.

Operational Execution & Deployment

  • Oversee day-to-day workforce allocation, ensuring field teams, sub-contractors, and technical specialists are fully vetted, badged, compliant, and deployed on schedule across customer sites.
  • Manage site-level shift schedules, travel logistics, and coverage rotations to minimize field burnout, control overtime expenses, and maintain continuous coverage on high-priority sites.
  • Serve as the primary onsite communication owner for workforce-related updates, including staffing levels, coverage risks, resource constraints, schedule impacts, and resolution plans.
  • Coordinate partner and resource onboarding readiness, including required documentation, system access, operational setup, and deployment readiness.

Governance & Risk Mitigation

  • Establish account-level WFM governance, actively monitoring staffing bottlenecks, credentialing delays, and labor risks.
  • Serve as a primary workforce liaison for union labor, partnering with union representatives, field leadership, and subcontractors to address workforce issues, escalations, and labor-related concerns.
  • Develop and drive corrective action plans and serve as the final escalation point for workforce issues.

Performance & Operational Reporting

  • Define, track, and report on core workforce metrics (e.g., resource utilization, schedule variance, deployment readiness, and forecast accuracy) to drive continuous operational improvement.
  • Conduct post-project WFM retrospective analyses to compare forecasted vs. actual labor utilization, pinpointing inefficiencies to continuously refine future account bidding and planning assumptions.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Coordinate across internal operations, external staffing partners, vendor management, and field leaders to maintain an agile, audit-ready workforce across dynamic data center environments.
  • Coordinate workforce-related invoice and accounts payable activities with Finance and Professional Services, including validation of supporting workforce and timekeeping information, resolution of invoice discrepancies, and escalation of payment issues that could impact partner performance or resource continuity.

What you have

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations, Human Resource Management, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, resource management, project delivery, service delivery, field operations, or data center infrastructure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large union or represented workforces, including direct experience partnering with union leadership and managing labor relations, workforce issues, and escalations required.
  • Experience supporting large-scale IT infrastructure, data center deployment, service center, or professional services delivery operations preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to model complex resource demand against volatile, fast-paced project schedules.
  • Skilled in navigating matrixed organizations, managing partner relationships, and briefing executive stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of workforce compliance, badging/site access protocols, and labor reporting frameworks.
  • Professional self-starter with strong business acumen and the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Legally eligible to work in the United States.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an Appointment Setter who can confidently engage business owners, build meaningful conversations, and create qualified sales opportunities for our team.

As an Appointment Setter, you will be the first point of contact for prospective child care centers and nursery businesses interested in growing their enrollment. You will identify opportunities, qualify prospective clients, build rapport with decision-makers, and schedule high-quality appointments for our sales team.

Your success will directly contribute to helping child care businesses grow while supporting the continued expansion of Childcare Marketing Group. This is more than a call-making role—it's about opening doors, building trust, and creating opportunities that lead to long-term client relationships.

Compensation

  • Salary Band: $800 per month
  • Performance Bonus: Opportunity to earn a discretionary year-end performance bonus based on individual contributions, overall performance, and company results.

Why You Should Work Here

● Work That Matters: You transform lives by connecting families who need quality child care with the providers who serve them.

● Recession-Proof Growth: An established, fast-growing company that continues to thrive while many competitors struggle.

● Leadership That Has Your Back: A supportive, attentive team that answers your questions and helps you grow, professionally and personally.

● An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business - not just a name on the door.

● Small-Team Feel: A friendly, tight-knit environment where you are a person, not a headcount.

● Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a fast-moving, collaborative team. Buffalo-area candidates may also have opportunities for occasional in-person meetings, strategy sessions, or team gatherings.

● Top-of-Market Pay: We pay above market because we hire the best and want to keep them.

● Train to Be the Best: Access $100K+ in training, courses, and materials - enough to make you more knowledgeable than 99.9% of the account managers our competitors employ.

●A Workspace That Feels Alive: Working from home can get lonely, so our virtual Sims-like office keeps the team connected day to day.

● Quarterly Town Halls: Every quarter, you get a full state-of-the-company update, so you are never guessing where things stand.

● The Dream-On Program: Each year, our CEO grants multiple wishes pulled straight from team members' dream boards.

● 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because we want you to have a real life outside work.

● Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days a year to volunteer with any charity you choose.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will develop a strong understanding of our ideal clients, confidently communicate our value proposition, and consistently deliver qualified appointments to the sales team. Ongoing, you will be measured on:

  • Qualified Appointments: Consistently schedule high-quality appointments with decision-makers who meet our qualification criteria.
  • Pipeline Growth: Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective clients through proactive outreach and follow-up.
  • Prospect Engagement: Build trust with business owners by understanding their challenges and positioning our solutions effectively.
  • CRM Accuracy: Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date prospect records, communications, and follow-up activities.
  • Conversion Support: Provide the sales team with well-qualified opportunities that improve appointment attendance and sales conversion rates.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute ideas to improve outreach messaging, scripts, processes, and appointment conversion.

A Typical Week Might Include

  • Contacting prospective child care business owners through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels.
  • Researching prospective clients and identifying organizations that match our ideal customer profile.
  • Qualifying prospects by understanding their enrollment goals, marketing challenges, and business needs.
  • Scheduling qualified appointments and coordinating calendars with the sales team.
  • Following up with warm prospects who require additional touchpoints before booking.
  • Updating CRM records, documenting conversations, and tracking outreach activities.
  • Reviewing appointment metrics and identifying opportunities to improve outreach effectiveness.
  • Participating in coaching sessions, role-playing, and ongoing sales training.

Key Competencies

  • Relationship Builder: You establish rapport quickly and make prospects feel comfortable and understood.
  • Confident Communicator: You communicate professionally, ask thoughtful questions, and guide conversations naturally.
  • Results-Oriented: You enjoy working toward goals, measuring success, and continuously improving your performance.
  • Resilient: You remain positive, persistent, and motivated despite objections or rejection.
  • Organized: You manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and appointments without losing momentum.
  • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your results and consistently look for ways to improve.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You dislike speaking with new people every day.
  • You become discouraged by rejection or objections.
  • You prefer waiting for inbound leads instead of proactively creating opportunities.
  • You struggle to stay organized with follow-ups and CRM updates.
  • You are uncomfortable working toward measurable performance goals.
  • You prefer routine administrative work over relationship building and sales conversations.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 2+ years of experience in appointment setting, lead generation, inside sales, telesales, business development, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Experience engaging business owners, executives, or decision-makers.
  • Strong listening skills with the ability to uncover business needs and qualify opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM systems and sales engagement platforms to manage pipelines and prospect activity.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-up and time management skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote-first environment.
  • Reliable home office setup with high-speed internet and the ability to work primarily on an Eastern Time schedule.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency or B2B sales environment.
  • Experience selling or booking appointments for marketing, SaaS, professional services, or business consulting.
  • Experience using CRM and sales tools such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using prospecting platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar lead-generation tools.
  • Experience working with child care, education, franchise, or multi-location businesses.
  • Demonstrated success consistently meeting or exceeding appointment-setting or sales activity targets.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position. Candidates should have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, noise-cancelling headset, HD webcam, and a professional home office environment. The role primarily supports North American clients and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

About Childcare Marketing Group

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

jobs.description:
Senior IT Operations Analyst

Position Title:Senior IT Operations Analyst

Department:Information Technology

Reports To:Technology Director

Location:Remote

Employment Type:Full-Time

Travel Requirement:None

About MedZed

MedZed is a leader in delivering value-based, technology-enabled social support to high-cost Medicaid members who are unreachable and disconnected from their primary care provider. We combine innovative outreach and care models with technology to find and engage members, connect them to primary care, and improve outcomes. Our intervention yields reduced costs and assists our members in enhancing their quality of life. As we scale, we are seeking an experienced Senior IT Operations Analyst to be part of the Technology Team.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior IT Operations Analyst — MedZed's experienced internal technology resource, equally comfortable handling day-to-day operational IT and taking initiative on process improvement, system health, and vendor oversight. Where the IT Operations Analyst responds to what comes in, the Senior Analyst is expected to anticipate, document, and improve. This person operates with a high degree of independence, surfaces risks before they become incidents, and serves as a reliable operational partner to the Technology Director and cross-functional teams including HR and Operations.

This role is appropriate for someone who has mastered the fundamentals of IT operations and is ready to take ownership of the function's reliability and continuous improvement — without necessarily moving into infrastructure engineering or people management.

Key Responsibilities

Support Operations — Ownership & Improvement

  • Own the internal support ticket queue end-to-end: triage, resolve, escalate, and track to closure.
  • Establish and maintain internal SLAs for response and resolution; monitor performance against them and report to the Technology Director.
  • Proactively identify patterns in support volume and root-cause recurring issues rather than resolving them repeatedly.
  • Build and maintain a self-service knowledge base that measurably reduces inbound ticket volume over time.

External Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational contact with MedZed's external IT managed services provider — with enough context and credibility to direct their work effectively.
  • Coordinate with the external security monitoring team (DeepSeas) on alert response and remediation; execute tasks such as access revocation, device isolation, and access record maintenance.
  • Provide the Technology Director with structured, fact-based escalations — not just problems, but context and recommended next steps.
  • Monitor vendor responsiveness and flag performance gaps proactively.

Equipment & Asset Management

  • Own the full hardware lifecycle: procurement, configuration, deployment, inventory, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Maintain audit-ready asset records; proactively manage refresh cycles and flag upcoming needs before they become urgent.
  • Operate within device standards set by the Technology Director; surface recommendations for standard changes as needs evolve.

Telecom Account Management

  • Own MedZed's Verizon corporate account: device procurement, line management, plan assignments, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Proactively identify cost optimization opportunities — underused lines, plan mismatches, renewal windows — and bring recommendations to the Technology Director.
  • Maintain complete and current records of all device assignments and account activity.

HR & People Technology

  • Oversee and own the technology provisioning and deprovisioning for all employee lifecycle events: onboarding, role changes, and terminations.
  • Own the provisioning checklist and continuously improve it as systems, roles, and HIPAA requirements evolve.
  • Anticipate upcoming onboarding or offboarding activity and prepare in advance rather than reacting at the last minute.
  • Serve as a trusted operational partner to HR — proactive, reliable, and easy to work with on time-sensitive transitions.

Process & Documentation

  • Maintain SOPs and runbooks for all recurring IT operations tasks — provisioning, deprovisioning, equipment deployment, ticket escalation, telecom changes.
  • Identify gaps in existing processes that create operational, security, or compliance risk and collaborate with the Technology Director for solutions.
  • Ensure all documentation is current, accessible, and usable by someone stepping in without prior context.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in IT operations or IT support, with demonstrated ownership beyond reactive ticket resolution.
  • Proven ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct without day-to-day supervision.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Working knowledge of Azure/Entra ID for identity and access management.
  • Experience with hardware procurement, MDM platforms, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Able to work effectively with HR, Finance, Operations, and non-technical leadership.
  • Process-oriented mindset — documents gaps, build standards, and follows through.
  • Ability to work under pressure and systematically organize complex problems into smaller solvable components.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to communicate problems and solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience in a healthcare or HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with security controls relevant to access management and endpoint hygiene.
  • Experience managing a corporate wireless account.
  • CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+; or Microsoft certifications (MS-900, AZ-900).

Career Path

The Senior IT Operations Analyst is a well-defined path toward IT management and technical specialization. Demonstrated success in this role — particularly proactive process ownership, vendor coordination credibility, and growing technical competency — creates a natural path toward:

  • IT Operations Engineer — for those who develop meaningful technical depth in platform administration, automation, or infrastructure.
  • IT Security & Compliance Analyst — deep operational involvement in access management, HIPAA provisioning controls, and security monitoring creates a foundation to specialize in healthcare IT security.

Physical Requirements

  • This position requires the employee to remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods while performing desk-based computer tasks.
  • The employee must be able to constantly operate a computer, keyboard, and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
  • The person in this position may need to occasionally move about inside the office/remote workspace to access file cabinets, office machinery, or other resources.
  • The employee may occasionally be required to lift and move objects weighing up to 10 pounds (e.g., a laptop, files, or small office equipment).
  • Clarity of vision at approximately 20 inches or less is required for working with computers and reading small print.

Reasonable Accommodation

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and California law, it is our policy to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause undue hardship.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • Germany

Responsibilities

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

  • Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
  • Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re not trying to “support R&D.” We’re trying to redefine how R&D works.

Technology is moving fast. AI is reshaping how teams build, think, and deliver. Most companies are reacting. We want to be ahead of it.

We’re looking for a Strategic People Partner who sees People as a system design problem, not a HR checklist. Someone who is deeply curious about AI, how work is evolving, and what high-performance looks like in modern engineering environments.

You’ll operate where technology, behavior, and organizational design collide, helping us build R&D teams that are fast, adaptive, and genuinely great to work in.

What You’ll Do

  • Design the next version of R&D: Work with engineering and product leaders to rethink org structures, team topology, and ways of working in an AI-accelerated world.

  • Cut through the AI noise: Translate “AI will change everything” into actual decisions: roles, skills, productivity, team composition. No fluff, just impact.

  • Rebuild People products for speed: Performance, hiring, onboarding, merit, talent… take what exists and make it work for builders. Less bureaucracy, more signal. If it slows teams down, it’s broken.

  • Bridge strategy and reality: Zoom out to define where we’re going. Zoom in to make sure it actually happens. No patience for strategies that live in slides.

  • Build teams for what’s next: Identify future capabilities early and make sure we have the talent to match. Not when it’s obvious, but before.

  • Upgrade leadership: Help leaders operate in ambiguity, make better decisions faster, and build teams that don’t burn out or slow down.

  • Protect what makes us human: As AI scales, double down on judgment, creativity, trust, and collaboration. The stuff that actually differentiates teams.

  • Use data, but think: Bring strong insights into decisions, but don’t hide behind dashboards when judgment is required.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • You’ve worked closely with R&D / engineering teams and get how things really happen

  • You’ve been part of meaningful transformation (not just polishing existing processes)

  • You’re comfortable tearing down and rebuilding core HR systems when they don’t fit

  • You’re genuinely curious about AI and the future of work (not just repeating headlines)

  • You’re proactive, sharp, and opinionated—you don’t wait to be asked

  • You’re comfortable in messy, fast-moving environments where clarity comes late

  • You believe People is a core driver of business performance, not a support layer

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviors.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Description

The project manager II has the overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical trials. The project manager II oversees and coordinates study resources to ensure compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements. Project Manager II acts as the main line of communication to relevant stakeholders and provides input to feasibility, study design, budget development and ensures progress reporting (resources, budget and timeline)

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You want to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects
  • You are looking to position yourself in an environment where you can grow your career alongside the company

IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES

﻿Client interactions

  • Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
  • Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
  • Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

  • Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
  • Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.
  • Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).
  • Lead study start-up activities including trial kick-off, TMF setup, site selection and activation, vendor set-up timelines, and site contracting and budgeting.
  • Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs to ensure timely submissions and completeness of essential documents prior to site initiation and throughout the study.
  • Partner with Data Management to ensure CRF alignment with protocol and sponsor requirements, and that data review, query resolution, and database lock timelines are met.

Quality and risk management

  • Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.
  • Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.
  • Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.
  • Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.
  • Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

Project budget and timelines

  • Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.
  • Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
  • Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
  • Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
  • Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

  • Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
  • Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
  • Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.
  • Define and maintain the project-specific training matrix and ensure training records are kept up to date throughout the study.

Requirements

Education

  • B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research

Experience

  • At least 5 years industry experience and a minimum of 3 years in Phase I-III clinical trial project management
  • Experience managing dermatology and/or rheumatology trials
  • Experience leading concurrent multi-centered clinical trials with budgets in excess of $3M USD.
  • Experience managing dermatology trials an asset

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, FDA and Canadian regulations
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English, French is an asset
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors
  • Good problem-solving abilities
  • Good organizational skills
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule / work schedule :
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and Rheumatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.
