Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth and build health savings for life. Through our innovative technology and superior service delivery, our members gain valuable insights to better save and spend their healthcare dollars.

People are our greatest asset. We firmly believe that our team members drive the success of this company. We hire passionate contributors who enjoy the thrill of pioneering their positions to their full potential. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position, and where our purple culture drives a remarkable experience.

The Senior AI Engineer is the dedicated architect and lead developer for our internal AI engineering platform, a strategic capability within IT Engineering. This role designs and builds the cloud-native application and the AI/LLM services that power our in-house AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, closing a gap where architecture and AI development had no dedicated owner. Today, this work is split across infrastructure-focused engineers whose mandate is Azure and cloud administration rather than direct application and AI development — which limits delivery velocity and creates key-person risk. Working collaboratively with IT Engineering leadership, Security and Compliance, and business teams adopting AI, this position will establish reusable patterns, frameworks, and guardrails that let the broader organization build AI safely — while remaining hands-on: writing application and integration code, building and integrating LLM/AI services, and taking our AI initiatives from architecture through production.

What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and developing AI/LLM-powered capabilities for internal business problems — including retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, prompt and model integration — using Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search).
  • Using agentic coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of day-to-day development to accelerate delivery and model best practices for AI-assisted engineering.
  • Establishing reusable patterns, frameworks, and guardrails for building AI applications — LLMOps/MLOps, evaluation, observability, and cost control — that other IT Engineering teams can adopt.
  • Partnering with Security and Compliance to ensure all AI and cloud application work is secure-by-design and meets HealthEquity's HIPAA and data-protection standards.
  • Serving as the technical point of contact and hands-on developer accelerating AI solution delivery across the organization.
  • Identifying opportunities where internally built AI tools can reduce reliance on third-party software, contributing to operational efficiency.
  • Contributing to the ongoing infrastructure and architecture of our AI engineering capability as a secure, scalable, cloud-native application on Microsoft Azure.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (IT, security, and business stakeholders) to ensure our AI capabilities meet business needs and align with organizational goals.
  • Working with business units to gather requirements and translate them into AI-powered solutions.
  • Monitoring and optimizing the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of our AI and cloud services.
  • Providing updates and recommendations to IT Engineering leadership on AI platform direction, adoption, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Recommending improvements to engineering processes, standards, and tooling to increase the safety and efficiency of AI development across the organization.
  • Mentoring and supporting other engineers as they adopt AI-assisted development practices and our platform's engineering patterns.
  • Performing additional duties as assigned or identified to support team objectives.

What you will need to be successful

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technology field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software or cloud application engineering, including recent hands-on AI/ML development.
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML and LLM-based applications, including the Azure AI portfolio (Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search), retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, and model integration and evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of day-to-day development.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong software development skills for cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure (e.g., App Service, Functions, containers/AKS, API Management, storage and data services).
  • Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, C#/.NET) and modern engineering practices: CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, automated testing, and observability.
  • Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Solid grounding in secure application design, identity (Microsoft Entra ID), API security, and data protection appropriate to a HIPAA-regulated environment.

Other Skills:

  • Architectural judgment — able to evaluate trade-offs (model selection, cost, latency, accuracy, safety) and design sound approaches in an ambiguous, fast-changing domain.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across Engineering, Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders.
  • Microsoft/Azure AI certifications are a plus but not required.

This is a remote position.

$120000.00 To $149500.00 / year

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. Click here to learn more.

You belong at HealthEquity!

HealthEquity, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being an employer where no matter your background or identity – you feel welcome and included. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a qualified individual with a disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: MA / NY / PA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes
  • The ability to hold credible conversations with engineers, architects, executives, finance teams, and procurement, and to adjust the message for each
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

Helpful, but not required

  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures
  • Containers, Kubernetes, and microservices
  • Data-intensive applications such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) and analytics platforms
  • Experience with grant-funded procurement, consortium purchasing, or public sector contract vehicles

If you meet most of the required list and few of the second list, we would still like to hear from you.

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:
$141,400—$234,500 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

Pure and simple.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Consumer

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL
Department: Product
Reports to: Chief Product Officer
Starting Pay Range: $155k - $172k/yr

About Work Truck Solutions

Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights.

We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis + upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don't just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a core area of the platform end to end—from the problem definition through to the metric that proves it worked.

This is not a backlog-grooming role. Our users are dealers, upfitters, OEMs, and fleet buyers whose workflows are genuinely complicated, whose data is genuinely messy, and who will tell you plainly when software wastes their time. You will spend real hours in the field understanding how a fleet buyer thinks about their truck, how it gets specced, upfitted, listed, and sold, then translate that into products that make the whole supply chain faster. You will also help define how AI shows up in our products—which parts of these workflows should be automated, augmented, or left alone—and hold the line on quality when the easy answer is to ship a demo.

You'll work closely with design, engineering, and data to sequence work that compounds, and you'll be measured on outcomes for the business and our customers rather than on shipping velocity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Consumer shopping experience, including the tradeoffs required to keep it focused.
  • Develop deep, first-hand understanding of dealer, upfitter, OEM, and fleet buyer workflows through customer conversations, ride-alongs, support data, and usage analytics.
  • Write crisp problem definitions, specs, and success criteria that give engineering and design room to solve rather than instructions to follow.
  • Define and instrument the metrics that matter for your area; run the analysis yourself rather than waiting on a request queue.
  • Partner with design on discovery and validation, and with engineering on sequencing, scope, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Identify where AI and ML meaningfully improve the product—data enrichment, search and matching, workflow automation, decision support—and scope those bets with honest evaluation criteria and clear failure modes.
  • Drive launches end to end: enablement for sales and support, customer communication, adoption tracking, and iteration after release.
  • Communicate up and out: keep executives, GTM teams, and customers aligned on what's coming, what changed, and why.
  • Contribute to the broader product operating model—discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, and how the team makes decisions.

Qualifications

Product craft
  • 6+ years in product management, with at least one area or product line you owned end to end and can speak to in detail—including what didn't work.
  • Demonstrated experience with complex B2B or marketplace products, ideally multi-sided, where different user groups have conflicting incentives.
  • Strong discovery instincts: you talk to users regularly, you distinguish what they ask for from what they need, and you kill your own ideas when the evidence says to.
  • Excellent written communication; your specs and updates reduce ambiguity rather than add to it.
  • Track record of shipping meaningful outcomes in an Agile environment, and comfort operating without perfect information.

Data and technical fluency
  • Self-sufficient with data: you write your own SQL or work fluently in your analytics stack, build your own dashboards, and don't outsource your understanding of your own metrics.
  • Comfortable with experimentation and measurement—choosing the right metric, sizing impact honestly, and knowing when an A/B test isn't the right tool.
  • Enough technical depth to hold a real conversation about APIs, data models, integrations, and system constraints, and to earn engineering's respect in design review.
  • Experience with data-heavy products where the quality and structure of the underlying data is itself the customer problem.

AI and ML product capability
  • Has shipped AI or ML features in production and can explain the tradeoffs made—not just the launch, but the evaluation approach, the failure cases, and what you did about them.
  • Practical understanding of what current AI is and isn't good at, and the judgment to say no to AI features that create more customer risk than value.
  • Comfortable defining quality bars for probabilistic systems: what accuracy is good enough, how errors surface to users, what the fallback is, and how you monitor degradation over time.
  • Understands the economics—inference cost, latency, human-in-the-loop review—and can build a business case that survives contact with those numbers.
  • Fluent with AI tooling in your own workflow (research synthesis, prototyping, analysis, drafting) and able to raise the team's practice without overselling it.
  • Able to partner credibly with data science and ML engineering: you can scope a model problem, interpret an evaluation, and push back when a metric doesn't reflect the user's reality.

Working style
  • High ownership and low ego; you'll do the unglamorous work when it's what the customer needs.
  • Demonstrated influence without authority across engineering, design, sales, and support.
  • Bias toward shipping and learning over exhaustive planning, paired with the discipline to follow through past launch.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Currently resides in one of the following states: CA, TX, FL

Nice to Have

  • Experience in automotive, dealership software, logistics, supply chain, fleet, or industrial B2B.
  • Background with catalog, taxonomy, configuration, or inventory data products.
  • Experience introducing AI capabilities into an existing product rather than building AI-native from scratch.
  • Comfort with field research in non-office environments—dealerships, upfit shops, service bays.

Why Join Us?

  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying connected to a collaborative team.
  • Impactful Work: Contribute to products that are reshaping the commercial vehicle industry.
  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a rapidly growing company with ample opportunities for professional development.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a team that values diversity, creativity, and innovation.

Ready to Drive Innovation?

If you want to own a product area where the problems are real, the users are direct, and the impact shows up in American businesses getting the vehicles they need to work, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out to us at with your resume.

Our sales teams help our customers get serious, reproducible, and secure value from data science using Posit’s enterprise platform: Workbench, Connect, and Package Manager.

This is an ideal role for someone building a foundation in technology sales: you’ll gain hands-on experience and develop key skills in a supportive environment, with direct alignment and coaching from our public sector sales leaders to accelerate your success.

Your Impact

This role exists to directly drive new expansion revenue within Posit’s existing customer base. You are singularly responsible for:

  • Partnering with Account Managers on existing accounts and converting expansion signals into generated pipeline, leading to upsell and cross-sell revenue.
  • Driving transactional excellence — qualifying, advancing, and closing opportunities that generate immediate, measurable revenue aligned to customer goals.

How You’ll Collaborate

You’ll work closely with people and teams across Posit to move deals forward and set customers up for success:

  • Partner with account managers, customer success, and product teams to ensure a seamless post-sale handoff, so expansions are implemented and adopted.
  • Work directly with sales leaders, who provide alignment, supervision, and coaching to accelerate your ramp.
  • Shadow and support senior reps on presentations and demos, taking on more responsibility as you progress.
  • Feed insights back to product teams on sales blockers and customer demand for new features.

What You’ll Bring

  • Prior experience in software sales - both sourcing and closing business - as an Inside Sales Representative or Account Executive/Manager.
  • A strong interest in inside sales, customer relationship management, and enterprise data / data science software.
  • A proven track record of qualifying interest and leading discovery efforts to bring solutions to customers' needs.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Good organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive, coachable mindset with a strong work ethic, willingness to hustle, and a positive attitude.

What You’ll Learn With Us

No one arrives knowing everything. Here’s what you’ll develop on the job:

  • Fluency in Posit’s product suite, the data science / AI market, and the competitive landscape.
  • Hands-on CRM proficiency (e.g., Salesforce) for logging interactions and managing pipeline hygiene.
  • Executing Posit’s sales motion - specifically mastering qualification and discovery phases of the sales cycle.

Your First Year

Within 1 month, you’ll…

  • Complete product and Inside Sales onboarding, and clearly articulate the value proposition of Workbench, Connect, and Package Manager.
  • Shadow customer calls and demos with senior reps, documenting the key discovery questions and objections you observe.
  • Set up your CRM workspace and accurately log all activity across your assigned account segment.

Within 3 months, you’ll…

  • Independently manage a portion of the expansion pipeline, maintaining accurate CRM data and regular check-ins.
  • Generate sales-qualified expansion opportunities (SQOs) across your aligned Account Manager’s book of accounts and progress steadily against your ramp target.
  • Run value-focused conversations that uncover immediate sales triggers with existing customer contacts.

Within 6 months, you’ll…

  • Consistently hit your quota, running discovery and value conversations end-to-end with limited oversight.
  • Develop a repeatable expansion playbook for your accounts.
  • Deliver structured product and customer feedback to product teams on blockers and feature demand.
  • Support presentations and demos with growing independence.

Within 12 months, you’ll…

  • Be fully ramped and consistently achieving quota.
  • Own and drive growth in your Account Managers’ book of business, deepening relationships with key contacts.
  • Serve as a mentor for newer team members.
  • Be on a clear progression path toward an Account Manager or Account Executive sales role.

Role Mission

Email Marketers manage and execute email marketing campaigns for our Rescue, driving engagement with supporters, adopters, and donors. You will be responsible for combining content from our Creative Pack (photo, video, copy), scheduling campaigns, and ensuring email lists are maintained and segmented appropriately. This role requires attention to detail, knowledge of email marketing platforms, and the ability to analyze performance metrics. You will be working remotely in a team environment; five hours of per week with flexible scheduling.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Creating Content

  • Combine photo, video, copy from Creative

  • Attention to detail, links, eye for graphic design and UX

  • Revises/improves current email templates and themes

Key Results Area #2 - Segmentation and Audiences

  • Work to create a wide range of segmented audiences built with CRM data points and behavioural feedback

  • Keeps an eye on user analytics and adjusts

  • Aware of email cadence and uses suppression lists

Key Results Area #3 - Scheduling and Automations

  • Schedules email, sensitive to deadlines

  • Monitor and report on email campaign performance

  • Keeps an eye on automation opportunities

  • Aware of holistic email marketing plan from entire team

Needed Skills

  • Experience with email marketing platforms and CRMs (We use Neon One)

  • Attention to detail, eye for graphic design

  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines as well as within a remote team

  • A Venn Diagram that overlaps with love of dogs and marketing

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one dog destination in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokanes love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, freedom and Jesus.

No NGO status here, we dont take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. Were about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We dont do drama. There are no victims here and the system isnt out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We dont bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where its normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dogs birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isnt being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

Helpware's AI Platform team builds a portfolio of AI-native products for customer support and business operations, all running on a shared multi-tenant platform. The team also implements these products for individual clients with custom configurations, integrations, and SLAs.

We're looking for two Senior QA Engineers to own quality end-to-end — from pre-release testing of the products themselves to validating each customer's live implementation. 8/9 AM — 5/6 PM EST
14:00/15:00 — 23:00/24:00 CET

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

The candidate is an organized "self-starter" who understands the intricacies of doing business with the federal government and has an intense attention to detail. Additionally, this position maintains responsibility for response review, editing, creating, and using compliant proposal templates in preparation for submission. The Proposal Specialist is responsible for all desktop publishing of the proposal templates using Microsoft Office Suite including TOC, Exhibits, Tables, Figures, Charts, Headers, Spacing control of text and integrated graphics, etc., and maintains standard operating procedures, content repositories and past performance libraries.

Our client is a U.S.-based construction company specializing in the development of community parks, amenity centers, recreational spaces, monuments, and other outdoor environments for residential developers and communities.

The company works closely with project managers, construction managers, landscape architects, and other industry partners to deliver high-quality projects with a strong focus on execution, cost control, and operational excellence.

As the organization continues to manage a growing portfolio of active construction projects, it is strengthening its financial and project accounting capabilities to provide greater visibility into project performance and costs.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Job Cost Accountant to own the accuracy and integrity of job cost data across an active portfolio of construction projects.

This role is dedicated to project financial performance and will be responsible for running and reviewing job cost reports, maintaining accurate cost coding, reconciling project financial data between Sage 100 and Procore, managing the monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule, and partnering directly with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

This is not a passive reporting role. The Job Cost Accountant will be embedded with project teams and serve as a financial partner to operations, helping ensure that costs are accurately captured, forecasts remain current, and project leadership has reliable financial information for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Job Cost Reporting & Accuracy

  • Run, review, and distribute weekly and monthly job cost reports from Sage 100 for all active projects.

  • Reconcile Procore commitments, change orders, and invoicing against Sage 100 job cost detail.

  • Identify financial variances and work with project teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.

  • Review cost coding for AP invoices, subcontractor billings, labor, and equipment charges before they close to the job.

  • Identify misallocated expenses and coordinate corrections with the appropriate project stakeholders.

  • Maintain an accurate cost code structure in collaboration with finance and project leadership.

  • Ensure job cost information rolls up accurately for financial reporting, project analysis, and estimating feedback.

Project Management & Construction Management Partnership

  • Conduct formal monthly job cost reviews with Project Managers and Construction Managers.

  • Review budget vs. actual costs, committed costs, job cost detail, and forecast-to-complete estimates.

  • Partner with project teams to identify and correct misallocated expenses.

  • Serve as a primary finance resource for questions related to job costs, cost code selection, and committed cost reconciliation.

  • Escalate recurring coding or accountability issues to finance and project leadership when appropriate.

WIP & Percentage of Completion

  • Own the monthly WIP schedule across all active projects.

  • Maintain accurate calculations for:

    • Cost to date

    • Estimated cost at completion

    • Percentage complete

    • Earned revenue

    • Over/under billings

  • Partner with Project Managers to validate monthly cost-to-complete estimates.

  • Identify and challenge outdated or unsupported project forecasts.

  • Deliver a clean, accurate, and defensible WIP package as part of the monthly financial close process.

Specialized Cost Tracking

  • Partner with project leadership to capture the true cost of specialized construction activities when deeper cost analysis is required.

  • Establish tracking approaches before activities begin, including appropriate cost codes, labor tracking, equipment capture, and reporting structure.

  • Ensure cost information is collected accurately in real time rather than reconstructed after project activities are completed.

  • Prepare actual-cost reporting that can support future estimating, purchasing, project planning, and strategic decision-making.

Systems, Reporting & Documentation

  • Work extensively in Sage 100 and Procore as the primary systems for project cost accounting.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent financial data across both systems.

  • Build and maintain Excel reporting workbooks summarizing job cost, WIP, committed cost, and project financial performance.

  • Use AI-enabled tools and services, where appropriate, to improve reporting, reconciliation, and document review processes.

  • Maintain organized documentation and strong data hygiene across project accounting workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Construction industry accounting experience is required.

  • Hands-on experience with construction job costing and project financial reporting.

  • Working proficiency with Sage 100 Contractor or Sage 100 construction job cost modules.

  • Working proficiency with Procore, including commitments, change orders, and invoicing.

  • Experience preparing and maintaining WIP schedules and percentage-of-completion calculations.

  • Strong understanding of cost codes, committed costs, project budgets, actual costs, and cost-to-complete forecasting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, reconciliations, and reporting workbooks.

  • Experience reconciling financial information across accounting and project management systems.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and coordinate corrections with operational teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting multiple active construction projects simultaneously.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will ensure that project financial data is accurate, timely, and actionable. The work is hands-on, systems-oriented, and designed for engineers who enjoy solving messy, real-world problems at scale.

You don't just use AI tools. You think natively in them. Your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and perform reviews. You'll help establish and evolve AI-native engineering practices for the Vertical Experiences team while delivering features that ship to production weekly.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $148,000 to $216,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $171,500 to $201,000 CAD.

Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer."We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary- therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services that support device connectivity, telemetry ingest, health monitoring, and command/control operations.
  • Collaborate with firmware, mobile, and product teams to define APIs and workflows for device features.
  • Deliver scalable, resilient systems in a microservices environment running on AWS (EKS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, etc.).
  • Build and own data pipelines for high-throughput streams using Kafka or similar streaming tech.
  • Instrument services for observability, reliability, and SLO compliance.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and live incident response.
  • Write clean, testable, performant code and help improve CI/CD and automation.
  • Orchestrate AI coding agents daily for spec writing, code generation, test authoring, incident triage, PR review, and system design

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience building backend services in Java, Go, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems.
  • Strong skills with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), container orchestration, and deployments.
  • Experience with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, and event/streaming systems.
  • Comfortable collaborating across teams and articulating technical tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on agentic AI workflow experience.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with IoT or telematics systems.
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other streaming platforms.
  • Experience with high-frequency ingest systems and time-series data.
    A background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Knowledge of SRE practices and automated testing frameworks.

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

  • Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team.

Our Benefits

  • Competitive pay and benefits.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Mental Wellness Program & EAP.

  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference.

  • Be a Good Person — We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect — We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. Department: Program Operations

Summary

SSP International, Inc. (SSPI) is a non-profit organization that is synonymous with excellence in science education. At SSPI, we are guided by a mission to offer students transformational opportunities to learn, do, and belong in science. Since 1959, SSPI’s flagship program, the Summer Science Program, has offered immersive summer research experiences that ignite curiosity and inspire a lifelong passion for discovery. Guided by our mission, SSPI is focused on embracing collaboration, building a lifelong community, and fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where participants, alumni, staff, and stakeholders feel valued, supported, and empowered. With a global network of over 5,000 alumni, we continue to pave the way for the next generation of leaders. More information on our mission, vision, values, and programs can be found at www.ssp.org.

The Program Coordinator position is responsible for assisting with the development and management of campus partner relationships, serving as a designated point-of-contact for internal and external stakeholders, and coordinating the operational and administrative processes for the Summer Science Program under the leadership of the Senior Director of Program Operations and in collaboration with the Program Operations and Academic Affairs teams. The Program Coordinator works closely with the Senior Directors of Program Operations and Academic Affairs to coordinate campus partnerships and contract processes, manage administrative tasks, and suggest process improvements while contributing to the effective and successful Summer Science Program.

The successful Program Coordinator will:

  • Monitor, track, and maintain the phases of campus partnership development that supports lasting and effective campus relationships

  • Maintain organized and up-to-date operational records, workflows, and documentation allowing for effective coordination

  • Identify and implement process improvements that can deliver more efficient operations

Essential Responsibilities

  • Under the direction of the Senior Director, coordinate the development and ongoing management of host campus relationships through researching prospective host campuses, communication with campus stakeholders, scheduling and conducting preliminary meetings assessing feasibility and suitability of prospective partners, and answering common questions related to cultivating new campus partnership opportunities.

  • Develop systems and processes for managing host campus details, including insurance, youth protection, supervision requirements, campus contacts, status tracking for legal agreements, procurement of consumables through university channels, tracking and analyzing price data, and contract and invoice reconciliation.

  • Reconcile contracts and invoices, submit payment requests to Accounting department in a timely and accurate manner, and track contract life cycles from request through payment.

  • Support Summer Science Program depts with administrative tasks such as researching and booking travel, guest speaker recruitment and logistics, communication with external stakeholders and entities, coordination with other teams, analyzing data, compiling reports, etc.

  • Communicate clearly and accurately with host campus designees to support program planning and execution, including ordering, tracking of lab consumables, collecting, and organizing program-specific details such as housing/dining/parking information.

  • Support budget, expense, and accounting review and reconciliation processes, including expense review and approval, submission of requests to Accounting department, and spending analyses.

  • Develop and maintain organized systems for recordkeeping, internal and external communications, setting checkpoints and meeting deadlines, in collaboration with team members and leadership. 

  • Develop and maintain documentation of workflow processes and on-campus operations guidelines.  

  • Assist with the campus strategy, planning, and operations cycle, in collaboration with team members and leadership. 

  • Address operational challenges in collaboration with team members and leadership. 

  • Under the direction of the Senior Director, develop, maintain, and improve systems for scheduling, training, staff development, communications, faculty performance and progress during summer operations, and collection and analysis of program feedback.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of program operations through the periodic review of processes, policies, and procedures, in collaboration with other team members and leadership.

  • Assist with admissions and enrollment as needed, including but not limited to application portal testing, screening applications, and participation in admissions discussions. 

  • Maintain professional and collegial communication and relationships with summer faculty, SSPI staff, and external stakeholders, and work collaboratively with the Education team to solve problems and ensure the success of summer program operations. 

Education and Experience

  • Minimum two-year degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in education, nonprofit organizations, STEM, or related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in an administrative role, K-12, higher education, or education-focused nonprofit organization.

Qualifications

  • Strong organizational and time management skills and able to take on multiple priorities in a growth environment

  • Proactive with a systems-oriented mindset focused on problem solving

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accurate and up to date recordkeeping

  • Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and tact.

  • Intermediate computer skills (Microsoft Office suite, databases, spreadsheets, reporting tools, project management software) and ability to learn new technology and software tools

  • Advanced interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to communicate succinctly and clearly, both verbally and in writing

  • Demonstrated commitment to maintaining positive relationships with external stakeholders

  • Experience coordinating multiple projects with competing priorities and deadlines

  • Experience communicating information to diverse audiences and confirming an accurate shared understanding

  • Understanding of access and equity issues for historically underrepresented populations in STEM education

  • Self-motivated with a demonstrated ability to work independently in a fully remote environment, effectively managing time, prioritizing tasks, and meeting deadlines while staying responsive and communicative.

  • Demonstrates commitment to SSPI’s Mission and Values in their daily work and interactions.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions

The working conditions described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Constantly operates a computer.

  • The ability to observe details at a close range and the ability to adjust focus.

  • The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

  • Travel campus locations, meetings, and staff gatherings (approximately 15 to 20 travel days in summer plus two in-person meetings in the spring and autumn).

Clearance Requirements

  • Authorization to work in the United States

  • Background clearance

The Virtual Territory Business Manager (VTBM) is a virtual sales professional responsible for driving demand generation, customer engagement, and business performance within an assigned territory Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, this role supports both pre-launch and post-launch commercial activities and executes approved strategic and tactical plans to achieve territory objectives.

The Virtual Territory Business Manager (VTBM) is a virtual sales professional responsible for driving launch readiness, successful product commercialization, and sustaining business growth within assigned territory through primarily digital and remote interactions. As the primary point of contact for the eye care community, the VTBM develops trusted partnerships with Retina specialists, comprehensive ophthalmologists, optometrists, genetic counselors, academic medical centers, referral networks, and other key healthcare stakeholders to educate on disease state, identify appropriate patients, and support the adoption of innovative therapies.

By leveraging customer insights, market analytics, competitive intelligence, and territory performance data, the VTBM identifies opportunities, prioritizes accounts, anticipates barriers to adoption, and implements targeted strategies that accelerate market uptake and optimize territory performance. Working collaboratively with cross-functional partners including Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and other field-based teams, the VTBM ensures coordinated execution of launch strategies, customer engagement initiatives, and access solutions that enhance customer experience and support patient access.

The Virtual Territory Business Manager must demonstrate effective virtual account management skills and engage nurses, pharmacists, physicians, genetic counselors, office administrators, and support staff through digital platforms to increase awareness of the brand and disease state.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Translate national brand strategy into a territory business strategy and corresponding tactical plan while meeting activity, access, and sales objectives.
  • Drive product adoption through pre-call planning, listening, probing, clinical messaging impact, and supporting complex patient access education.
  • Build and maintain proficiency in the disease state, patient journey and product knowledge to deliver compelling clinical and diseases state awareness aligned with approved messaging and compliance standards.
  • Conduct high-quality virtual customer engagements utilizing approved promotional materials, digital resources, and compliant messaging.
  • Establish and maintain productive relationships with ophthalmologists, retina specialists, inherited retinal disease (IRD) specialists, genetic counselors, and other key stakeholders through telephone, video conferencing, email, and approved digital communication channels.
  • Leverage digital engagement tools, analytics, and customer insights to prioritize opportunities and maximize business impact.
  • Exhibit an ownership mindset by emphasizing customer prioritization, thoughtful resource allocation, and an analytical view of opportunities.
  • Monitor and adapt based on lead/lag indicators (identified patients, referral pathways, diagnostic odyssey engagement, specialty pharmacy pull-through) and escalate competitive intelligence and field insights to sales leadership.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, account plans, and territory activities within approved CRM systems.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Strategic thinking and execution excellence
  • Demonstrated advanced clinically based selling skills
  • Collaborative and adaptable ways of working
  • High-level customer partnership and development
  • Patient centric mindset
  • Strong business acumen and market insight with an ownership mindset
  • Cross-functional influence and collaboration
  • Adaptability in complex, evolving markets

COMMUNICATION SKILLS:

  • Effectively communicate approved clinical and scientific information related to the brand to healthcare professionals, ophthalmologists, IRD specialists, genetic counselors, and office staff through virtual engagements.
  • Deliver compelling disease state education and product information while remaining compliant with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct impactful video meetings, virtual presentations, webinars, and remote educational programs with healthcare professionals and office personnel.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements below represent the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for this role.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, specialty healthcare sales, inside sales, virtual sales, or customer engagement experience with a demonstrated record of business success.
  • Ophthalmology experience strongly preferred.
  • Virtual pharmaceutical sales or omnichannel customer engagement experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ophthalmology practices, retina centers, academic medical centers, referral networks, and the ophthalmology market landscape.
  • Knowledge of inherited retinal diseases, ophthalmology treatment pathways, and patient identification processes preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, execute, and manage strategic account plans in a virtual environment.
  • Proven success in developing customer relationships and influencing treatment adoption through remote engagement channels.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Existing relationships with ophthalmologists, retina specialists, IRD specialists, genetic counselors, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) are highly valued.
  • Experience supporting therapies that require genetic testing or specialty patient identification processes preferred.
  • Rare disease launch experience preferred.
  • Virtual pharmaceutical sales, inside sales, customer success, tele-sales, or omnichannel engagement experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated success utilizing digital engagement strategies to drive customer adoption and business performance.

Infrastructure & Automation

jobs.title: Copywriter & CRO-Experte - Shopify (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Du öffnest unseren Onlineshop, siehst tausende Besucher pro Tag – und weißt genau: Viel zu wenige davon kaufen tatsächlich.
jobs.description:
Du öffnest unseren Onlineshop, siehst tausende Besucher pro Tag – und weißt genau: Viel zu wenige davon kaufen tatsächlich. Genau das änderst du ab jetzt – mit Worten, die verkaufen.

Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 qualitative Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr, über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen mittlerweile auf unsere Produkte. Unser Shopify-Store ist bereits achtstellig, unser Ziel ist neunstellig bis 2030.

Der Shop läuft, die Basics stehen. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der richtig gut verkaufen kann – auf der Produktseite, in der Headline, im letzten Satz vor dem Kaufen-Button, einfach überall. Als unser neuer Copywriter & CRO-Experte (in Vollzeit – 40 Stunden pro Woche) verantwortest du alles, was Kunden auf unserem Shop lesen, fühlen und letztendlich kaufen.

Wichtig: Bei uns geht es nicht um Programmieren, Klickarbeit oder technische Umsetzung – das erledigen unser Entwickler (und moderne KI-Tools). Du bringst das, was KI nicht ersetzt: Verkaufspsychologie, Copywriting und ein Gefühl dafür, was Menschen tatsächlich zum Kaufen bringt.

Aufgaben

Du schreibst die Texte, die auf unserem Shop verkaufen – Produktseiten, Headlines, Landingpages, Kaufargumente, etc.. Du verstehst unsere Kunden, unsere Produkte und findest die Worte, bei denen Besucher denken: "Das brauche ich, und zwar am Besten zu gestern!".

Du verantwortest die komplette Customer Journey unseres Onlineshops – von der Produktseite bis zum Checkout – und optimierst sie laufend weiter. Conversion-Rate-Optimierung ist bei uns ein Never-Ending-Process, und weil wir laufend neue Produkte launchen, wird dir garantiert nie langweilig.

Du schaust auf unsere Kennzahlen (Conversion Rate, Average Order Value, Revenue per User), verstehst, wo Kunden im Kaufprozess abspringen, und setzt genau dort mit besserer Copy und besserer Nutzerführung an.

Fürs Design, steht dir unsere KI und bei Bedarf unser Team zur Seite. Für alles Technische, unser Backend-Entwickler. Die Strategie, die Ideen und die Worte kommen von dir.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist in erster Linie Copywriter und Verkäufer: Du hast schon Texte geschrieben, die messbar mehr verkauft haben, und kannst uns das zeigen – mit Beispielen und Zahlen.
  • Du bist in Verkaufspsychologie zuhause und weißt genau, warum Menschen kaufen – und warum nicht. Du führst Besucher Schritt für Schritt bis zum Kaufen-Button.
  • Du hast bereits für einen erfolgreichen E-Commerce Store gearbeitet (idealerweise D2C) und kennst die Kennzahlen, an denen deine Arbeit gemessen wird: CR, AOV, RPU.
  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung sind uns weniger wichtig als nachweisbare Erfolge – zeig uns, was du schon geschrieben und verkauft hast.
  • Du bist ein KI-native: Du nutzt die neuesten Tools selbstverständlich, um schneller zu recherchieren, zu testen und Varianten zu bauen – aber du weißt auch, dass gute Copy am Ende von dir kommt, nicht vom Prompt.
  • Ein echtes Growth Mindset: Du willst besser werden, bist neugierig und passt dich an, wenn sich Markt und Tools verändern.
  • Shopify-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, kein Muss – alles Technische übernimmt unser Entwickler, das Frontend lernst du bei uns schnell.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch fließend und fehlerfrei – das ist bei dieser Rolle nicht verhandelbar, denn deine Worte sind das Produkt.

Benefits

  • Du wirst nicht zum Klicken eingestellt: Alles Operative und Technische übernehmen unser Entwickler und KI-Tools. Du konzentrierst dich zu 100 % auf das, was du am besten kannst – Texte, die verkaufen.
  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du gestaltest die komplette Verkaufsseite unseres achtstelligen Shopify-Stores mit dem Ziel, gemeinsam bis 2030 neunstellig zu wachsen – und siehst direkt an den Zahlen, was deine Worte bewirken.
  • Top-Gehalt für Top-Leute: Wir wissen, dass richtig gute Copywriter selten sind und was sie wert sind. Unsere Range spiegelt das wider.
  • 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von wo du willst, solange du in Europa lebst, deine Deadlines einhältst, an den wenigen Meetings teilnimmst und erreichbar bist.
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Kein Umweg über drei Ebenen – du sprichst direkt mit den Leuten, die entscheiden.
  • Ehrliches Feedback statt Nettigkeiten – das bringt dich und uns schneller weiter als höfliches Drumherumreden.
  • Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr, bei denen man sich auch mal ohne Bildschirm dazwischen sieht.

Klingt das nach deiner nächsten Stelle? Dann wollen wir kein Anschreiben lesen, sondern deine Texte: Zeig uns Produktseiten, Landingpages, Ads oder Verkaufstexte, die du geschrieben hast – gerne mit den Ergebnissen (Conversion Rate, AOV, Umsatz).

Wichtig: Bewerbungen ohne Textproben sortieren wir aus. Wir suchen hier einen absoluten Profi – und den erkennen wir an dem, was du bereits geschrieben und verkauft hast, nicht an dem, was du über dich schreibst.

Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter "CV" hoch. Alles andere – Textproben, Kennzahlen, ein kurzes Wort zu dir – packst du einfach ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du dafür nicht.

Wenn du dir vorher noch ein Bild von uns machen willst: Auf unserer Karriereseite lernst du das Team kennen und siehst, wie wir arbeiten.

Tabea und das Valkental-Team freuen sich auf dich!

jobs.excerpt: Customer Success Engagement Manager About ChariotChariot is a SaaS company building a modern operating system for the moving industry, starting with moving company management software.
jobs.description:
Customer Success Engagement Manager


About Chariot

Chariot is a SaaS company building a modern operating system for the moving industry, starting with moving company management software. Our MVP launched in Spring 2022, and we've rapidly expanded across the US, with our founders and engineers based in NYC.

Moving is a universal, stressful, and expensive experience that’s ripe for disruption. ~35M Americans (~10% of the country) move every year, with businesses, non-profits, government agencies, and military families also requiring moving services. This creates a massive moving economy, with a ~$30B industry of moving companies at the center.

Running a moving company is complicated, high-stress work. Most moving companies still rely on a disjointed mix of generic online tools and paperwork for sales, field service management, and back-office operations. We believe the lack of modern tools for movers is the critical challenge hindering major innovation in the moving experience.

Chariot addresses this problem with a simple, modern software platform that boosts sales conversions, reduces work to schedule and dispatch moves, simplifies move day, improves customer service, and streamlines payment collection. We're pursuing ambitious new product directions to expand our market size and impact for moving companies and customers.

Our founding team brings experience from Google, Flatiron Health, Cedar, Bain & Company, Bridgewater, Teachable, KeyMe, and ASAPP. We're backed by VC firms and co-founders of successful vertical SaaS companies, and advised by moving company owners nationwide.

PLEASE NOTE:

  • This role is remote or hybrid if located in the NYC metro

  • This role will also require after-business hours and weekend coverage for our Help Desk, one week per month or as needed.

What You'll Do

The Customer Success Engagement Manager will play a critical role in scaling Chariot’s hands-on, high-quality customer experience. You’ll own a book of accounts, work the health metrics daily, and drive retention and growth through proactive outreach. You’ll work closely with the Head of Customer Success and our Product Support. This is a high-ownership role on a small team.

Customer Health & Engagement

  • Review customer health metrics daily and identify customers that are declining, stalled, or at risk

  • Proactively reach out to at-risk customers to drive adoption and get them back on track

  • Own a book of accounts and run regular check-ins to keep customers engage and using the product

  • Run quarterly business reviews with “VIP” customers that reinforce value, and surface expansion opportunities (upsells, quarterly → annual conversions)

  • Identify customers who have stalled in onboarding and re-engage them to complete setup

  • Track and report on engagement trends across customer base

  • Maximize business value of healthy customers by driving referrals and upsells

Help Desk & Support

  • Support the help desk on an as-needed basis, including a 1-week-per-month on-call rotation for after-hours/weekend coverage.

  • You’ll be responsible to:

    • Respond to customer questions via help desk with fast SLAs

    • Triage product questions and escalate appropriately while maintaining customer ownership

    • Identify recurring issues and contribute to improved documentation and internal processes

Also Part of the Role

  • Help with billing and payment-related questions

  • Occasionally run onboarding and training calls, support onboarding follow-ups and setup tasks

Who You Are

You may come from one of the following backgrounds:

  • 2-4 years in customer success, customer support, or account management role within a SaaS or technology company, ideally with ownership over renewals, retention, or expansion
    OR

  • Experience working in the moving industry, ideally in a management, or operations-focused role, with a comfort working in software platforms
    OR

  • 2+ years in an operations, account management, or client success role involving data-driven decision-making, proactive client communication, and ownership over a portfolio or set of outcomes

In addition, you:

  • Are driven about learning, growing your skillset, and advancing your career. You embrace the opportunities of working at a startup and find ways to make an impact without being asked.

  • Are comfortable working with data – you’ll be able to look at a health score, spot what is declining, and what to do about it. You can think critically about how to improve data and systems to make yourself more effective.

  • Are a confident, proactive communicator. You don’t wait for customers to reach out, you reach out first. You’re not afraid to pick up the phone, text, and stay persistent to reach a customer.

  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through managing a full book of accounts without anything important falling through the cracks.

  • Comfortable working with small business owners and employees in a “blue-collar” industry.

  • Are flexible and low-ego – this is a small team, so you’re willing to help with support tickets, billing questions, or other tasks when needed, even if it’s not your main focus.

  • Are excited to deeply learn a complex product and become an expert in how moving companies operate.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience at an early stage startup (Seed, Series A)

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products

  • Experience supporting SMB customers (in the moving industry or another “blue-collar” industry)

  • Familiarity with help desk systems (Zendesk, Intercom, etc.)

  • Experience with HubSpot

Compensation

  • Salary: $65-90k + equity (depending on location & experience)

  • Benefits & Perks

    • Unlimited vacation

    • Competitive salary and significant equity

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with comprehensive benefits

    • 401(K)

    • WFH equipment budget (for remote employees)

  • Freddie improves sexual health through education, prevention, and treatment with a focus on the LGBTQ2S+ community. As the #1 rated PrEP provider in North America, we’re proudly dismantling barriers to sexual healthcare for patients across both Canada and the USA.
  • Frida transforms the lives of patients through easier access to adult ADHD diagnosis and fast, affordable treatment.
  • Foria provides trans, non-binary, and gender-diverse Canadians with specialized, gender-affirming healthcare.
  • Affirming Care Pharmacy provides discreet, specialty prescription delivery across North America. Operating from six central hubs—Calgary, Mississauga, and Toronto in Canada, and Los Angeles, New York City, and San Antonio in the US—the team provides patients with an integrated, end-to-end healthcare experience.

We are proud to be ranked #2 on Deloitte’s 2024 list of Canada’s 50 fastest-growing tech companies and recognized as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures for two consecutive years. Driven by a strong mission, our team is passionate about making healthcare accessible to those who need it most—and we make sure to have fun along the way!

Independent Contractor (1099) opportunity through OpenLoop

Location & Schedule: Remote (United States). We’re looking for someone who can commit 20–30 hours weekly, split between up to 20 hours of live patient consultations and 5–10 hours of asynchronous tasks. To maintain consistent patient coverage, at least 10 of your live consultation hours must be completed between Friday and Sunday.

Who we hope to find:

Come and join the #1 rated PrEP provider in North America, Freddie! We are looking for a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse licensed in multiple states to provide high-quality, virtual sexual health care to our patients across the U.S.

At Freddie, our patients are our #1 priority—we’re passionate about delivering an exceptional, 11/10 star experience. Our team provides empathetic, stigma-free, and client-centered care for those seeking preventative care through PrEP (Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis) and DoxyPEP, as well as treatment for those living with HIV. This role requires strong clinical skills, excellent communication, and a commitment to reducing health disparities within diverse populations, including those in the LGBTQ2IA+ community.

In this role, you’ll make an impact by:

Providing Compassionate, High-Quality Synchronous Care (~20 hours/week of live consultations)

  • Delivering inclusive, expert, virtual care through scheduled synchronous consultations through our virtual care platform
  • Leading comprehensive initial assessments for those seeking preventative HIV care, including but not limited to: history taking, risk assessment, and psychosocial evaluations
  • Providing comprehensive sexually transmitted and blood borne infection (STBBI) prevention education to clients (with a focus on HIV prevention), including risk reduction strategies and behavioural counseling
  • Championing health education and empowerment, helping patients understand their treatment options, navigate stigma, and take control of their wellness

Supporting Seamless Asynchronous Patient Care (5-10 hours/week of flexible async tasks)

  • Providing asynchronous care to ensure timely and continuous support for patients, including reviewing results, providing education, and clinical follow-ups
  • Maintaining accurate, detailed patient records in our Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system, using a wide variety of virtual tools to chart and connect with patients
  • Collaborating with our team of Nurse Practitioners and support team members to support end-to-end patient care

We need someone who has:

  • An active Registered Nurse compact state license
  • 3+ years of experience in a clinical nursing role
  • Clinical experience in a semi-independent practice role in medical patient care and/or sexual health
  • Experience providing virtual healthcare
  • Excellent communication skills and empathetic care delivery
  • Experience working in HIV prevention and/or with the LGBTQ2IA+ community
  • Consistent availability for asynchronous patient care tasks (reviewing results, providing education, follow-ups) and up to 20 hours weekly for scheduled shifts, including live consultations. Task volume may vary based on state licensure and patient needs

It would also be great if you have:

  • Additional non-compact state licenses, with NV and/or OR being a strong plus
  • Experience working with gender and sexually diverse communities
  • Experience working in the private sector, a start-up, or a technology company
  • Fluency in Spanish

Compensation:

  • Compensation is task-based, but on average, independent contractors can expect to earn approximately $40-$50 per hour. Clinicians who are comfortable with virtual care and efficient workflows often exceed this amount.
  • Please note that as an independent contractor, you would not be eligible for the benefits available to permanent positions and would be required to provide your own laptop
  • This role offers the opportunity to flexibly contribute your skills and expertise, making it ideal for those seeking a dynamic and adaptable work schedule

Do you think you could be our next Registered Nurse? We look forward to seeing your application!

Why you should join us:

  • Be part of a team of great people who don’t take themselves too seriously. While we’re serious about the problems we solve, we believe in having fun along the way.
  • Make an impact, every single day. We’re providing compassionate, affirming care to many people who have never received the proper support before.
  • Be confident in bringing your whole self to work. Inclusivity is core to how we take care of our patients, our teammates, and ourselves. We create spaces that are safe and affirming.

What we’re offering (based on full-time, permanent roles in Canada & the USA):

Along with the benefits below, we offer additional programs and supports designed to help you feel your best—both at work and outside of it.

  • Work flexibly within a team that’s remote friendly; we believe that work should fit around your life*
  • 20 vacation days and a team that will remind you to use them!

  • $500 learning fund to use towards courses and other professional development
  • Our unique People Potential program, in which you'll partner with your manager to identify opportunities to grow and achieve your full potential

If you are looking for a place that sparks your creativity, helps others, and will push you to be your best, then you’ll love PurposeMed.

PurposeMed is committed to being an equal-opportunity employer, and we highly encourage those from excluded and marginalized communities to apply.
